$schema_note: Public accounting ledger for SourceMint (SRCMNT). Invariant: every on-chain transfer OUT of a project wallet must have an entry here with a stated reason. Verified against the chain by script/verify_ledger.py in CI.

entries.reason: Genesis: full fixed supply minted to deployer at deployment. No further minting is possible.
Treasury split: fund the contributor rewards wallet (10% of supply).

Treasury liquidity provision: seed the ETH/SRCMNT pool on Aerodrome (basic volatile, 0.3%) with 10,000 SRCMNT and 0.012 ETH, so contributor rewards are exchangeable rather than symbolic. LP tokens are held by the treasury wallet.
